title: Sherb Literary Living Room Featuring Pam Houston with Her New Book: "Animals Taught Me Everything"
copy: @ Doors: 6:00 PM || Talk starts: 6:30 PM || $15 entry Setting: Seated Join us for our Literary Living Room as Pam Houston features her just-published book, Animals Taught Me Everything. Brought to you by Second Chance Humane Society, Circle of Dreams Foundation, and The Sherbino What can a wagging tail and soaring wings teach us about a life well lived? From Icelandic mares and Irish wolfhounds to elephants, leopards, hyenas, and a desert-adapted lioness named Charlie, Pam Houston has learned life’s most important lessons from animals. How to play. How to rest. How to love. How to die. How to be present with the dying. How to be present with the living and with the Earth. How to find joy in the least likely places. How to find joy, literally, everywhere. …

title: Warren Miller's "Days Off" ~ Presented by The Sherbino, Citizens State Bank and Circle of Dreams Foundation
copy:
@ 			
			
							
		
			




Doors: 6:00pm || Film: 6:30pm || $12 advance General Admission || $10 advance Students ||  Price Goes Up at the door:  $15 General Admission / $12 students



Wednesday, November 4



This fall, drop in on Warren Miller’s 77th film, Days Off. Follow host Katie Burrell as the world’s best athletes show you what they do on their days off—no agenda, no competition, just pure, unscripted joy.



Embark on a global journey from heli-drops in Alaska and high-alpine mountaineering in Chamonix to the legendary powder of Hokkaido, Japan. Take a ride down Banff’s infamous skijoring course, hit the slopes of Deer Valley, and charge Canada’s finest in Revelstoke, Whistler, and Pemberton. Days Off captures the raw, unfiltered heart of mountain culture—a pure celebration of skiing for skiing’s sake and the joy of making time for what matters most.



Winter’s greatest tradition is back.

Something Was Calling Us



Sooner or later, a voice asks us to listen. It may carry a memory, a lost love, an echo of someone gone, or the hope of finding our way back. Wistful, tender, and occasionally strange, these stories follow the quiet pull of love, loss, identity, and change—and the unexpected paths we take toward what is missing.

title: The Sherbino & Citizens State Bank Present: Winter Wildlands Alliance BACKCOUNTRY FILM FEST
copy: Winter Wildlands presents the Backcountry Film Festival at the Sherbino—an inspiring night of human-powered adventure and winter storytelling. ❄️🎬 📅 November 18, 2026 | Doors 6 PM • Films 6:30 PM @ TICKETS The Sherbino and CSB Present: Winter Wildlands Alliance Backcountry Film Festival Doors: 6:00pm || Films: 6:30pm || $10 students and seniors (18-/ 65+) || $15 General Admission The Backcountry Film Festival, presented by Winter Wildlands Alliance, celebrates the power and spirit of humans in winter. Since its inception, the festival has toured across states, countries—even Antarctica—screening hundreds of inspiring films that celebrate adventure, conservation, and the magic of winter. Over the years, the festival has raised millions of dollars to support local projects that strengthen winter communities and protect our wild snowscapes. The 2026-27 winter season is the 22st anniversary of the Backcountry Film Festival! …
